text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! My heart's a-pound'n and I'm burn'n up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Goddesses, if I keep on doing my best, will I also b'come a bona fide city girl someday?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait… are you try'n to tell me I've got what it takes t'be a city girl?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you kindly! I promise t'do my bestest!
